page.overview:
Who is Cabin Proprietor?

The Cabin Proprietor is an unseen character mentioned on a signpost in Cool, Cool Mountain in Super Mario 64 and Super Mario 64 DS. He/she is only mentioned on the Signpost outside the chimney entrance of the slide in Cool, Cool Mountain, the sign tells the reader that Santa Claus isn't the only one who can climb through a chimney, the Cabin Proprietor also tells the reader (through the message on the sign) to jump in. Jumping through leads to the slide where two Power Stars can be found, there are also Coins here which are crucial for getting the 100-Coin Star.
